sections.title: Coordinate geometry
facts: Distance $\sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2}$; midpoint: average the coordinates.
Slope $\frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$; perpendicular slopes multiply to $-1$.

sections.title: Areas on the grid
facts: Shoelace: $\frac{1}{2}\left|\sum (x_i y_{i+1} - x_{i+1} y_i)\right|$, corners in order.
Grid points on a segment: $\gcd(\Delta x, \Delta y) + 1$.

sections.title: Transformations & symmetry
facts: Two parallel mirrors: a shift of twice the gap. Two crossing mirrors: a turn of twice the angle.
A regular $n$-gon: $n$ lines of symmetry, rotational order $n$.

sections.title: 3D solids
facts: Cylinder $\pi r^2 h$; cone and pyramid $\frac{1}{3}$ base $\times$ height; cone curved area $\pi r \ell$.
Lengths $\times k$: areas $\times k^2$, volumes $\times k^3$.

sections.title: Nets & space diagonals
facts: Space diagonal $\sqrt{a^2 + b^2 + c^2}$; cube $s\sqrt{3}$, face $s\sqrt{2}$.
Shortest surface path: unfold into a flat net and draw a straight line.
Euler: $V - E + F = 2$; an $n$-gon prism has $3n$ edges.
